## Motivation #39517 reports that NEXTN on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 memory-faults on MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X when the attention backend is aiter (ROCm 10 nightlies, both fp8 and bf16 KV). A plain server is fine. The faulting kernel is CK `mha_batch_prefill` (`FmhaBatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel`), with `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT`, on the first draft step. #### Root cause On HIP, Qwen3.5 MTP draft attention is `HybridAttnBackend` over `AiterAttnBackend`, and `supports_hip_draft_extend_graph` is false for that backend, so every `draft_extend` is eager. Eager `DRAFT_EXTEND_V2` builds a short `qo_indptr` (one entry per draft token) and an exact-sized page-id list, then stores them only on `ForwardMetadata`. The CK launch reads `self.qo_indptr[:bs]`, which the prompt extend just filled with the prompt length, and `metadata.max_kv_len`, which that branch leaves as `None`. The kernel trusts `cu_seqlens_q` and reads off the end of a 2-token Q. It also reads 128 page ids past the last token; the prefill updater pads that tail, `generate_attn_arg_prefill` does not. #30105 already routes this step through `unified_attention` (GQA-packed + split-KV) and defaults `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND` on. The call site still AND-ed `_use_unified_verify`, which requires `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN`. On the default aiter backend that kernel never runs. This PR does not add a kernel. It lets the existing one run, and it repairs the CK fallback for `topk>1` and for the env kill switch. #### In pictures Before (default aiter server with NEXTN): ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Draft-extend step
2 new tokens, long KV"] --> B{"Fast-path gate
needs SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1
(off by default)"} B -- "closed" --> C["CK mha_batch_prefill
Q length: whole prompt, not 2
max KV length: None
page list: no padding"] C --> D["GPU memory fault"] classDef bad fill:#fde2e2,stroke:#c0392b,color:#000 class D bad ``` After (same server, same settings): ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Draft-extend step
2 new tokens, long KV"] --> B{"Fast-path gate
non-MLA, topk ≤ 1,
SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND (default on)"} B -- "default" --> C["unified_attention"] B -- "topk > 1 or flag off" --> D["CK mha_batch_prefill, fixed
correct Q length and max KV length
page list padded by 256"] C --> E["No fault"] D --> E classDef good fill:#dff5e3,stroke:#1e8449,color:#000 class C,D,E good ``` Why the padding matters (the CK kernel reads 128 page ids past the end of the list): | | Real page ids | What the kernel over-reads | |---|---|---| | Before | `7 8 9` | `? ? ? …` memory the list does not own | | After | `7 8 9` | `7 7 7 …` 256 copies of a real page id | ## Modifications - `aiter_backend.py`, call site: gate `draft_extend_v2` on a new `_use_unified_draft_extend` instead of `_use_unified_verify` (and drop the redundant env conjunct). It is computed once at init as `not use_mla and SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND and topk<=1`, reading `speculative_eagle_topk` from the spec config (the registry constructs `AiterAttnBackend` without the eagle topk, so `self.topk` is always the default 1). Non-MLA `topk<=1` now takes `unified_attention` even when prefill and target verify stay on their current kernels. `topk>1` stays on CK, because `unified_attention`'s causal flag does not represent a tree mask. - Same file, CK fallback (producer side only): in eager `DRAFT_EXTEND_V2` metadata, publish the short `qo_indptr` into the shared buffer, set `max_kv_len` (via the existing `seq_lens_cpu.max()` idiom), and pad the page-id tail by 256 with a live page id, matching `AiterIndicesUpdaterPrefill`. The `forward_extend` consumer is left identical to upstream. - `environ.py`: document that `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND` now applies without `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN`. The default stays `True`. Target verify is unchanged. - `test/registered/amd/test_aiter_draft_extend_metadata.py`: unit test for the CK-fallback page-id pad. ## Accuracy Tests `test/registered/amd/test_aiter_draft_extend_metadata.py` (`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd`) covers the CK-fallback pad (live-id tail, empty stays empty). Rerun pending on `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.20-rocm10-mi35x-20260920` after the test was trimmed to a single case. End-to-end, the issue's NEXTN shape on the local Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MXFP4 checkpoint (same eager `draft_extend_v2` path; no 122B download). TP=2, `--attention-backend aiter`, `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=0`, page size 16, fp8 KV, `--speculative-algorithm NEXTN`, topk 1, 2 draft tokens. MI355X, gfx950. | Run | What the log shows | 32-token completion | |---|---|---| | default (`SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND` unset) | `Aiter draft extend uses unified_attention` on both ranks; gfx950 asm verify kernel loads | HTTP 200, no `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT` | | `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND=0` | that line is absent; aiter JIT-builds `mha_batch_prefill` | HTTP 200, no memory fault | Server warmup itself is a generation, and it returned 200 on both runs before the explicit request. ## Speed Tests and Profiling No new kernel and no launch-geometry change. #30105 already measured the short-Q CK kernel at about 0.2% of HBM bandwidth; this PR is what lets that unified path run when unified attention is not also turned on for prefill and target verify. No throughput sweep in this PR. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). — no user-facing docs change; the env flag comment is updated in code. - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #36719146405](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36719146405) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #36719146590](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36719146590) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #36719146829](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36719146829)

nodes.body: @yichiche CI clear. Feel free to review and happy to adjust if you have any feedback.

I'm the reporter of #39517. CI only got as far as the first AMD stage here, so I ran the setup from that issue on two cards, gfx950 and gfx942.

**Setup:** `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x-20261001` and `-mi30x-20261001` (sglang `0.5.21.dev20261001+g41cbe65de0`), with this PR's two python files patched in (head `1eb32bd8b`; applies cleanly). `Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8`, TP1, `--attention-backend aiter --page-size 16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --disable-radix-cache`, NEXTN with 1 step / topk 1 / 2 draft tokens. Batch 1, 128 output tokens, prompts of 186 / 1,862 / 11,150 tokens, best of two.

- **Without the PR, same image:** the `ck_tile ... FmhaBatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel` memory fault on the first prefill (the 80-token warm-up) on both cards, same as #39517.
- **With the PR:** no fault on either card. `Aiter draft extend uses unified_attention (topk<=1).` shows at startup, and the new unit test passes. With `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND=0`, the CK fallback also runs clean.

Decode tok/s (186 / 1,862 / 11,150 prompt tokens):

| | MI350X (gfx950) | MI325X (gfx942) |
|---|---|---|
| no spec | 144.6 / 144.2 / 143.6 | 65.1 / 65.1 / 65.0 |
| NEXTN, this PR | 215.8 / 176.1 / 108.4 | 61.4 / 56.0 / 48.4 |
| NEXTN, this PR, `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND=0` | 212.4 / 173.1 / 106.3 | 62.5 / 54.4 / 47.6 |
| NEXTN, `--attention-backend triton` | 206.0 / 185.2 / 174.7 | 59.8 / 52.8 / 45.9 |

So the crash is fixed on both. One thing I noticed: on gfx950, NEXTN is +49% at short context but drops to 0.75x of no-spec at ~11k tokens, while triton holds 1.22x there. My guess is that's target verify still going through `mha_batch_prefill`, as the env comment says. Not a blocker for this PR, just mentioning it in case it's useful.

*I used an AI assistant for the test harness and to tidy this up; the runs are mine, and I have the logs.*

@jolpindo96 Thanks for the feedback! The slowdown reproduces on my MI355X (`Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8`, TP2, your flags). The cause I found is target verify running Triton `extend_attention_fwd` (no split-KV). 

Setting `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` can help here:

| Decode tok/s | 186 | 1,862 | 11,150 | 30,000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| no spec | 138.0 | 137.7 | 137.1 | 134.5 |
| NEXTN, this PR | 177.3 | 164.4 | 103.0 | 59.0 |
| NEXTN, this PR, `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` | 191.3 | 196.6 | 190.4 | 188.7 |
| NEXTN, `--attention-backend triton` | 174.0 | 170.4 | 158.1 | 141.8 |

At 11k, that Triton kernel takes 554 µs per call vs 14 µs with unified verify. This predates the PR, so I'll handle it in a follow-up.

Confirmed on MI350X (gfx950) with my setup (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8, TP1, same flags, this PR patched into the 20261001 nightly): with `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1`, NEXTN stays flat.

| Decode tok/s | 186 | 1,862 | 11,150 | 29,070 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| no spec | 143.8 | 143.4 | 142.9 | 141.9 |
| NEXTN, this PR | 218.1 | 173.3 | 105.0 | 59.8 |
| NEXTN, this PR, `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` | 219.9 | 205.1 | 207.2 | 205.5 |

The env doesn't change no-spec decode (144.1 / 143.9 / 143.0 / 141.7), and it no longer dies at CUDA-graph capture on gfx950 like it did for me in September (#39517). Thanks, happy to test the follow-up.

*Same AI-assisted harness as my earlier comment.*

- **Existing bug**, already on main. [#39517](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/39517): NEXTN on Qwen3.5 faults on MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X with the aiter backend. A server without NEXTN is fine. The fault is CK mha_batch_prefill on the first draft step, because that launch reads the prompt-length qo_indptr left in the shared buffer.
- **AMD-only**. NVIDIA never enters this backend. Keeping the fix here is the right place.
- **No new kernel**. Default non-MLA topk <= 1 now reaches the existing unified_attention path from #30105 without SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN. topk > 1 and SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND=0 stay on CK, with the short qo_indptr published and the page-id tail padded by 256, matching AiterIndicesUpdaterPrefill.
LGTM.

files.patch:
@@ -571,10 +571,10 @@ class Envs:
     # page tables (DP attn); paged backends like trtllm_mha consume it directly.
     SGLANG_USE_HND_KVCACHE = EnvBool(False)
 
-    # Attention (aiter, ROCm): route NEXTN spec draft_extend (EAGLE-v2 KV
-    # catch-up) through aiter unified_attention (GQA-packed + split-KV) instead
-    # of the occupancy-starved mha_batch_prefill FMHA. Independent kill-switch
-    # for the new path; pairs with SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY. Default on.
+    # Attention (aiter, ROCm): route NEXTN/EAGLE draft_extend through aiter
+    # unified_attention instead of mha_batch_prefill. On by default for non-MLA
+    # topk<=1 even when prefill/target verify keep their default kernels; set 0
+    # for the CK fallback. Target verify still requires SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN.
     SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND = EnvBool(True)
     # Attention (aiter, ROCm): hand chunked prefill the page-level KV view so
     # gfx950 fp8 hd256 takes aiter's paged-varlen asm kernel. That kernel is

@@ -284,6 +284,19 @@ def _asm_context_prefill_gather_indices(
     return tok_idx, cu_k
 
 
+# mha_batch_prefill over-reads 128 page ids past the last token (see
+# AiterIndicesUpdaterPrefill); 256 keeps that tile inside the buffer.
+_MHA_PREFILL_KV_INDEX_PAD = 256
+
+
+def _pad_mha_prefill_kv_indices(kv_indices: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Repeat a live page id into the tail the CK prefill kernel over-reads."""
+    if kv_indices.numel() == 0:
+        return kv_indices
+    pad = kv_indices[:1].expand(_MHA_PREFILL_KV_INDEX_PAD)
+    return torch.cat([kv_indices, pad])
+
+
 class AiterAttnBackend(AttentionBackend):
     # kv_indptr/qo_indptr are preallocated at (req pool + 1); an extend batch
     # can never carry more seqs than the pool.
@@ -454,6 +467,18 @@ def _pool_is_vec5d(pool):
             and self.topk == 1
             and get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_VERIFY", "1")
         )
+        # Draft-extend only (prefill/target verify keep their kernels). Read the
+        # eagle topk from the spec config: the registry builds this backend with the
+        # default topk=1, so self.topk is 1 even when the server runs topk > 1.
+        # topk > 1 stays on the CK path.
+        draft_extend_topk = get_spec().speculative_eagle_topk
+        self._use_unified_draft_extend = (
+            not self.use_mla
+            and envs.SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND.get()
+            and (draft_extend_topk is None or int(draft_extend_topk) <= 1)
+        )
+        if self._use_unified_draft_extend:
+            logger.info("Aiter draft extend uses unified_attention (topk<=1).")
 
         # aiter kernel related initialization
         self.max_num_partitions = (
@@ -1788,6 +1813,14 @@ def init_forward_metadata(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch):
                         self.req_to_token,
                     )
                 )
+                # CK fallback: publish this step's short qo_indptr into the
+                # shared buffer (prompt extend left it at the prompt length),
+                # set max_kv_len, and pad the page ids the kernel over-reads.
+                kv_indices = _pad_mha_prefill_kv_indices(kv_indices)
+                n_qo = qo_indptr.shape[0]
+                self.qo_indptr[:n_qo].copy_(qo_indptr)
+                qo_indptr = self.qo_indptr[:n_qo]
+                max_kv_len = int(forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu.max().item())
                 self.forward_metadata = ForwardMetadata(
                     kv_indptr,
                     kv_indices,
@@ -3497,16 +3530,14 @@ def forward_extend(
                 )
                 return o.view(-1, layer.tp_q_head_num * layer.v_head_dim)
 
-            # draft_extend (EAGLE-v2 KV catch-up) is decode-shaped: short Q
-            # (accepted tokens) against long paged KV, GQA. The default
-            # mha_batch_prefill_func FMHA has no split-KV, so at short Q it is
-            # occupancy-starved (~0.2% HBM BW, ~400x over the memory floor).
-            # Route it through unified_attention (GQA-packed + split-KV), exactly
-            # like target_verify, so it runs near the memory floor.
+            # draft_extend (EAGLE-v2 KV catch-up): short Q, long paged KV. Route
+            # it to the #30105 unified_attention path. Gating on
+            # _use_unified_draft_extend (not _use_unified_verify) lets the
+            # default aiter backend take it; topk>1 and the kill switch fall
+            # through to the padded CK path below.
             if (
-                self._use_unified_verify
+                self._use_unified_draft_extend
                 and forward_batch.forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2()
-                and envs.SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND.get()
             ):
                 bs = forward_batch.batch_size
                 if layer.qk_head_dim != layer.v_head_dim:

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+"""Pad for the aiter CK draft-extend fallback: mha_batch_prefill over-reads 128
+page ids past the last token; draft extend must pad that tail or the kernel faults."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=20, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd")
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.version.hip, "ROCm attention backend")
+class TestAiterDraftExtendMetadata(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_pad_repeats_a_live_index(self):
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention import aiter_backend as ab
+
+        idx = torch.tensor([7, 8, 9, 10], dtype=torch.int32)
+        padded = ab._pad_mha_prefill_kv_indices(idx)
+        self.assertEqual(padded.shape[0], idx.shape[0] + ab._MHA_PREFILL_KV_INDEX_PAD)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(padded[: idx.shape[0]], idx))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.all(padded[idx.shape[0] :] == idx[0]))
+        self.assertEqual(ab._pad_mha_prefill_kv_indices(idx[:0]).numel(), 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

issue_comments.body: @yichiche CI clear. Feel free to review and happy to adjust if you have any feedback.

I'm the reporter of #39517. CI only got as far as the first AMD stage here, so I ran the setup from that issue on two cards, gfx950 and gfx942.

**Setup:** `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x-20261001` and `-mi30x-20261001` (sglang `0.5.21.dev20261001+g41cbe65de0`), with this PR's two python files patched in (head `1eb32bd8b`; applies cleanly). `Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8`, TP1, `--attention-backend aiter --page-size 16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --disable-radix-cache`, NEXTN with 1 step / topk 1 / 2 draft tokens. Batch 1, 128 output tokens, prompts of 186 / 1,862 / 11,150 tokens, best of two.

- **Without the PR, same image:** the `ck_tile ... FmhaBatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheKernel` memory fault on the first prefill (the 80-token warm-up) on both cards, same as #39517.
- **With the PR:** no fault on either card. `Aiter draft extend uses unified_attention (topk<=1).` shows at startup, and the new unit test passes. With `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND=0`, the CK fallback also runs clean.

Decode tok/s (186 / 1,862 / 11,150 prompt tokens):

| | MI350X (gfx950) | MI325X (gfx942) |
|---|---|---|
| no spec | 144.6 / 144.2 / 143.6 | 65.1 / 65.1 / 65.0 |
| NEXTN, this PR | 215.8 / 176.1 / 108.4 | 61.4 / 56.0 / 48.4 |
| NEXTN, this PR, `SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND=0` | 212.4 / 173.1 / 106.3 | 62.5 / 54.4 / 47.6 |
| NEXTN, `--attention-backend triton` | 206.0 / 185.2 / 174.7 | 59.8 / 52.8 / 45.9 |

So the crash is fixed on both. One thing I noticed: on gfx950, NEXTN is +49% at short context but drops to 0.75x of no-spec at ~11k tokens, while triton holds 1.22x there. My guess is that's target verify still going through `mha_batch_prefill`, as the env comment says. Not a blocker for this PR, just mentioning it in case it's useful.

*I used an AI assistant for the test harness and to tidy this up; the runs are mine, and I have the logs.*

@jolpindo96 Thanks for the feedback! The slowdown reproduces on my MI355X (`Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8`, TP2, your flags). The cause I found is target verify running Triton `extend_attention_fwd` (no split-KV). 

Setting `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` can help here:

| Decode tok/s | 186 | 1,862 | 11,150 | 30,000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| no spec | 138.0 | 137.7 | 137.1 | 134.5 |
| NEXTN, this PR | 177.3 | 164.4 | 103.0 | 59.0 |
| NEXTN, this PR, `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` | 191.3 | 196.6 | 190.4 | 188.7 |
| NEXTN, `--attention-backend triton` | 174.0 | 170.4 | 158.1 | 141.8 |

At 11k, that Triton kernel takes 554 µs per call vs 14 µs with unified verify. This predates the PR, so I'll handle it in a follow-up.

Confirmed on MI350X (gfx950) with my setup (Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8, TP1, same flags, this PR patched into the 20261001 nightly): with `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1`, NEXTN stays flat.

| Decode tok/s | 186 | 1,862 | 11,150 | 29,070 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| no spec | 143.8 | 143.4 | 142.9 | 141.9 |
| NEXTN, this PR | 218.1 | 173.3 | 105.0 | 59.8 |
| NEXTN, this PR, `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` | 219.9 | 205.1 | 207.2 | 205.5 |

The env doesn't change no-spec decode (144.1 / 143.9 / 143.0 / 141.7), and it no longer dies at CUDA-graph capture on gfx950 like it did for me in September (#39517). Thanks, happy to test the follow-up.

*Same AI-assisted harness as my earlier comment.*

reviews.body:
- **Existing bug**, already on main. [#39517](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/39517): NEXTN on Qwen3.5 faults on MI300X, MI325X, and MI355X with the aiter backend. A server without NEXTN is fine. The fault is CK mha_batch_prefill on the first draft step, because that launch reads the prompt-length qo_indptr left in the shared buffer.
- **AMD-only**. NVIDIA never enters this backend. Keeping the fix here is the right place.
- **No new kernel**. Default non-MLA topk <= 1 now reaches the existing unified_attention path from #30105 without SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN. topk > 1 and SGLANG_AITER_UNIFIED_DRAFT_EXTEND=0 stay on CK, with the short qo_indptr published and the page-id tail padded by 256, matching AiterIndicesUpdaterPrefill.
LGTM.
